title: Synthesis
description: The chair's final Act-I output (Phase G), composed ONLY from verified findings. The chair controls delivery tone; it may NOT alter severity, delete the kill_shots array, or average away dissent (grounding rules 4, 8).

verdict.description: 3-6 sentences. Validity verdict dominates venue verdict.

prioritized_findings.description: The verified findings, prioritized. must-fix capped at ~5-7; sorted by magnitude, not seat seniority.

panel_summary.description: How the verification panel ruled, e.g. 'upheld 6/7 angles; severity revised High->Medium per robustness check'.

contribution_memo.description: NON-BLOCKING, capped at 3. Composed ONLY from verified contribution-undersell findings (fed to the chair through their own channel); the engine strips any of their ids from prioritized_findings in code. Suggestions the author ratifies or ignores (rule 14); never raises a severity, never moves a verdict.

bolder_claim.description: The claim the paper could defensibly make but never does.

grounded_in.description: The quoted under-leveraged result (the finding's quote-gated foothold).

improvement_memo.description: OPT-IN and NON-BLOCKING (empty unless the run is in Improvement Mode, improvement: true). Composed ONLY from verified improvement-proposal findings (fed to the chair through their own channel); the engine strips any of their ids from prioritized_findings and caps the list to the mode's budget (3 at Roundtable up to 12 at Summit). Bolder substantive suggestions the author ratifies or ignores (rule 14); never raises a severity, never moves a verdict, never enters the must-fix list.

improvement.description: The substantive change the paper could make to be stronger.

grounded_in.description: The quoted foothold result or passage the proposal builds from.

kill_shots.description: VERBATIM, un-deletable. The harshest surviving objections from the fatal-flaw and pre-mortem seats, reproduced unsmoothed regardless of delivery tone.

validity_verdict.description: Is the central claim actually supported? Dominates the venue verdict.

minority_report.description: A specific, grounded dissent preserved intact even if it lost.

rejected_suggestions.description: Suggestions considered and dropped during verification, with reasons. Includes panel-rejected findings.
